motionGrammar.principle: World response begins from the real event, reads before copy settles, and leaves authoritative state visible.
motionGrammar.easing: whole-pixel stepped frames for authored raster motion; short engine-time arcs only for the independent bottle socket
motionGrammar.camera: fixed shipping camera; no shake or cut
motionGrammar.audio: not added because no approved audio family was selected by the asset lane

stateGraphs.graph: idle <-> walk-4dir; interact -> brew-anticipate -> brew-follow-through -> carry; carry + gate -> route-settle; carry + Mira -> deliver -> idle; idle + plot -> choose -> idle
stateGraphs.fallback: current locomotion or persistent carry state
stateGraphs.overlap: locomotion remains responsive during route settle

stateGraphs.graph: idle <-> focus; interact -> anticipation -> rim-response+bubbles -> cooldown -> resolved
idle gate + unrouted bottle -> activated gate -> traveling effect -> converted bottle -> settled gate
stateGraphs.fallback: converted bottle and settled activated gate

stateGraphs.graph: waiting -> anticipate -> relief|mismatch -> 900ms readable hold -> settled -> plots active; plot focus -> selected, sibling disabled
stateGraphs.fallback: settled reaction plus visible active/selected/disabled plots

stateGraphs.graph: controls -> feedback -> recovery|resolved; world cues normal -> focus -> pressed -> settle
stateGraphs.fallback: current authoritative status and one bottom context message

eventBindings.response: brew anticipation, rim answer, bubble crest, bottle settle, then concise feedback
gate response, traveling effect, persistent bottle conversion, then status
handoff, anticipation, readable reaction, plots activation, resolved instruction
selection ring, upward mote, disabled desaturation, persistent NEXT state

interruptions.brew: gameplay state commits immediately; interruption leaves the bottle visible in its authoritative state
interruptions.route: route mutation commits once; repeat crossings cannot duplicate the effect or quantity change
interruptions.delivery: delivery and reaction properties commit immediately; follow-up plots activate after the readable hold
interruptions.selection: selection and disabled sibling commit immediately; animation can finish without changing anchors
interruptions.recovery: one-shot pulse does not roll back, teleport, or replace the world

ambientContinuity.owner: World environment Sprite2D consumers and Mira
ambientContinuity.behavior: two authored environment frames change only light/glint pixels; collision edges, anchors, and traversable silhouettes are identical
ambientContinuity.competitionPolicy: ambient cadence is slower and lower-amplitude than focus or consequence motion

transitions: interaction -> action through the real brew input
action -> feedback through the real Area2D crossing
feedback -> resolution through the real Mira interaction
resolution -> transition through the real physical plot interaction
all transitions retain one place and one fixed camera

providerProvenance.method: direct authored pixel frames plus engine-native state choreography

trustBoundary: Motion is live and state-linked in current candidate engine captures; the downstream factory-owned probe must refresh trusted shipping-input evidence.
